description_en: Queries virus alerts detected by a virus scan on a specific server
description_zh: 查询病毒扫描具体机器扫描出的病毒告警
name: ListVirusScanMachineEvent

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page in a paged query
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page in a paged query
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，显示的每页数据的最大条数
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the task generated by a handling operation.
You can call the [OperateVirusEvents](~~OperateVirusEvents~~) operation to handle alerts and generate this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
执行处置操作生成的任务ID。
您可以调用[OperateVirusEvents](~~OperateVirusEvents~~)接口处置告警来生成该参数
parameters.name: operate_task_id

parameters.help_en:
The language type for the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

Data.description_en: The details of the alert events

items.description_en: The data returned when the call is successful
items.description_zh: 接口调用成功时，返回的数据

Details.description_en: The details of the exception event

InfoType.description_en:
The display type of valueDisplay.
Valid values:
download_url: download link
InfoType.description_zh:
valueDisplay的展示类型。
取值：
download_url: 下载链接

NameDisplay.description_en: The display name of the alert event

Type.description_en:
The display format of the exception event details.

Valid values:

text: plain text
html: rich text
Type.description_zh:
异常事件详情信息展示的方式。

取值包括：

text：文本方式
html：富文本的方式

ValueDisplay.description_en:
The additional attribute information of the exception event.
For example, the logon time or logon location for an unusual logon alert, or the trojan file path or trojan type for a trojan alert
ValueDisplay.description_zh:
异常事件的其他属性信息。
例如：异常登录告警的登录时间或登录地点、告警的木马文件路径或木马类型等

EventId.description_en: The ID of the alert event

EventName.description_en: The name (subtype) of the alert event

LastTimeStamp.description_en: The timestamp of the last occurrence, in milliseconds
LastTimeStamp.description_zh: 最后一次发生的时间戳，单位为毫秒

Level.description_en:
The risk level of the alert event. Valid values:
serious: Critical.
suspicious: Suspicious.
remind: Reminder
Level.description_zh:
告警事件的危险等级。取值：
serious：紧急。
suspicious：可疑。
remind：提醒

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the current page in a paged query
CurrentPage.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码

PageSize.description_en: The maximum number of entries per page in a paged query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，显示的每页数据的最大条数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of alert events returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的告警事件的总条数

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for each request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
